Koning et al. (2018): Adoption fraction among five countries with the most similar export patterns; EIU risk peers as alternative
Implemented measure and boundary: COW raw exports: five highest Pearson correlations with at least20 common observed destinations; fixed2000, fixed2013 from2014, and annual-lag to2015. At least3/5 dated policy peers (4/5 sensitivity). Unknown peers and bounds retained. EIU data unavailable.

Koning et al. (2018): Among ten geographic neighbours, median GDP growth of prior adopters exceeds nonadopters; GDPpc alternative
Implemented measure and boundary: Ten GeoDist capital-distance neighbours, priorG<=t-2 versus laterG>t-1, signals datedt-1; GDP/GDPpc, liquidity changes, and foreign benchmarked contrasts excluding the focal country/cluster from controls. Require80 percent signal coverage per relevant group.

Koning et al. (2018): Berry cultural/administrative composite; IFAC professional-advocacy membership alternative
Implemented measure and boundary: Official-language and legal-origin peer adoption fractions plus fixed2000 generic IGO similarity. Partial separate proxies: religion/composite and historical IFAC advocacy remain missing.

Koning et al. (2018): IMF credits and foreign aid relative to GDP; positive-resource indicator alternative
Implemented measure and boundary: Lagged IMFcredit+SDR/GDP, net aid/GDP, sum and complete-case positive indicator. SDR is not verified conditional lending; aid and credit measures do not establish pressure for any policy.
